_doc: Outline sources the walkthrough knows, so onboarding can say what exists for a place. `area` is a rough box [south, west, north, east] used only to say which entries are worth a look, never as data. `fetch`: automatic = a command here fetches it; manual = used by the site's own build scripts (scripts/build_regions.py and others), not yet by the walkthrough; login = needs an account. Better ones for a place than these are looked for on the web when a glacier is onboarded; add what is found with `npm run walkthrough -- add-source`. Licences are not stated here: they are read from the source's own page in the region step.

sources.name: GLAMOS Swiss Glacier Inventory (SGI 2023, 1973, 1850)
sources.offers: newest outline 2023 and the 1850 outline, with the inventory's own ids and areas

sources.name: Icelandic Met Office glacier outlines (about 1890 and 2025; Hannesdóttir et al. 2020)
sources.offers: an outline of about 1890 and of 2025 for the ice caps of Iceland

sources.name: NVE glacier inventory of Norway (outlines 2018-2019 and 1947-1985)
sources.offers: the main glaciers (hovedbre) with outlines of two inventories

sources.name: Norwegian Polar Institute glacier outlines of Svalbard (1936-1972, 1990, 2001-2010, 2020)
sources.offers: named glacier units with outlines of four epochs

sources.name: Randolph Glacier Inventory 6.0, via GLIMS
sources.offers: one outline of about 2000 for every glacier on Earth, with the inventory's id, name, area, length and heights

sources.name: GLIMS Glacier Database: dated outlines
sources.offers: outlines of many dates where contributors supplied them (for many Alpine glaciers back to 1850)

sources.name: Randolph Glacier Inventory 7.0 (NSIDC-0770)
sources.offers: a newer global inventory than RGI 6.0, one outline per glacier from about 2000
sources.how: files at https://daacdata.apps.nsidc.org/pub/DATASETS/nsidc0770_rgi_v7/ answer HTTP 401 without an Earthdata Login (checked 26 Oct 2026); download by hand

sources.name: Glacier inventory of the Alps from Sentinel-2 (Paul et al., 2019/2020; outlines 2015, some 2016), Austria, France, Italy, Switzerland
sources.offers: one 2015 Sentinel-2 outline set for the Alps, with area, centre and country per glacier (no names); download c3s_gi_rgi11_s2_2015_v2.zip (shapefile)
sources.how: download https://store.pangaea.de/Publications/PaulF-etal_2019/c3s_gi_rgi11_s2_2015_v2.zip and read it with walkthrough/sources/shapefile.ts; fields AREA_KM2, LAT, LON, Date, Country
